skill_name: Explain two ways in which social media affects marketing.
workflow: Social media has changed many aspects of modern marketing.One of the major ways in which it has transformed the field is by allowing for quick, wide-reaching communication. Companies now have access to new and ongoing conversations with customers, potential customers, and others from whom valuable information can be gleaned.
